Rashi on Yevamot 44a:12:1.hebrew: אלמה לא - בתמיה. כלומר, ואי שתי בתים בעלמא פטורה, מי לא איצטריך למיסר צרת ערוה? והא איצטריך. סד"א: ערוה אבראי קיימא ולא רמיא קמיה, והויא לה צרת בית אחד ותתייבם, קמ"ל:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:12:1.english: Why not? - [This is asked] in astonishment. That is to say: even if two houses [i.e., wives] in general are exempt [from levirate marriage], is it not necessary to forbid the rival wife of a forbidden relation? Indeed, it is necessary! [For] it could enter your mind to say [that] the forbidden relation stands outside and does not fall before him [for levirate marriage], and thus [the rival wife] is [like] a single house, and she should enter into levirate marriage; [therefore, the verse] teaches us [that she is forbidden].

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:14:1.english: Here Rabbi taught - In this Mishnah Rabbi taught us: "One should not spill," etc.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:15:1.english: One who remarries his divorcée - After she was married [to another man].

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:15:2.english: And one who marries his ḥalutza - For she stands [prohibited] to him under the negative commandment of "he shall not build again."

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:15:3.hebrew: והנושא את קרובת חלוצתו - לקמן בעי לן בגמרא, הא קרובת חלוצתו לאו דאורייתא היא:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:15:3.english: And one who marries a relative of his ḥalutza - Later on, we ask in the Gemara: Behold, a relative of his ḥalutza is not [forbidden] by Torah law.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:15:4.hebrew: יוציא והולד ממזר - דסבר ר"ע יש ממזר מחייבי לאוין:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:15:4.english: He must divorce [her] and the offspring is a mamzer - For Rabbi Akiva holds [that] there is a mamzer from [relations forbidden by] negative commandments.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:16:1.hebrew: קרובת גרושתו - דגרושתו כאשתו, ואחותה או אמה חייבי כריתות נינהו לגביה:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:16:1.english: A relative of his divorcée - For his divorcée is like his wife, and her sister or her mother are [relations] liable to karet for him.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:17:1.english: Say: A relative of his divorcée - And the Rabbis disagree regarding one who remarries his divorcée and one who marries his ḥalutza.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:19:1.hebrew: ודלמא הא קמ"ל דיש ממזר מחייבי כריתות - וה"ק: אע"ג דפליגי רבנן בחייבי לאוין, מודים הם בחייבי כריתות שהולד ממזר:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:19:1.english: And perhaps this teaches us that there is a mamzer from those liable to karet - And this is what it is saying: Even though the Rabbis disagree regarding those liable for [ordinary] negative commandments, they concede regarding those liable for karet that the offspring is a mamzer.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:1:1.hebrew: היתה אחת כשרה - לכהונה, ואחת פסולה, כגון שנתגרשה מאיש אחר:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:1:1.english: One was fit - [to marry] into the priesthood, and one was unfit, such as where she had been divorced from another man.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:1:2.hebrew: אם בא יבם לחלוץ חולץ לפסולה - ולא יפסול את הכשרה לכהונה, דלא ישפוך אדם מי בורו ואחרים צריכים להם, אע"ג דהוא אין צריך להם:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:1:2.english: If a yavam comes to perform ḥalitza, he performs ḥalitza with the unfit [woman] - and he should not disqualify the fit [woman] from [marrying into] the priesthood, for a person should not pour out the water of his cistern while others need it, even though he [himself] does not need it.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:21:1.english: And perhaps he was actually not speaking about it - And [as for] what you said, [that if he meant] to teach us other [prohibitions] liable to karet [why teach a relative of his divorcée?].

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:21:2.hebrew: איידי דתנא רישא מחזיר גרושתו ונושא חלוצתו וקרובת חלוצתו - ופליגי רבנן עליה, תנא נמי ומודים בקרובת גרושתו. אבל קרובת חלוצתו, ה"נ דלר"ע הוי ממזר:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:21:2.english: Since the first clause taught: one who remarries his divorcée, and one who marries his ḥalutza, and a relative of his ḥalutza - and the Rabbis disagree with him, [the mishna] also taught: "And they concede regarding a relative of his divorcée." However, [regarding] a relative of his ḥalutza, it is indeed so that according to Rabbi Akiva [the child] is a mamzer.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:22:1.hebrew: הכתוב קראו ביתו - ולית ליה סתמא דמתני' בריש פרקין (יבמות מא.), דקתני: "החולץ ליבמתו ונשא אחיו את אחותה ומת — חולצת", דלר״ע פטורה לגמרי:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:22:1.english: The verse called it "his house" - And [Rabbi Akiva] does not hold [in accordance with] the anonymous Mishnah at the beginning of our chapter (Yevamot 41a), which teaches: "If one performs chalitzah for his yevamah, and his brother married her sister and died, she performs chalitzah" — for according to Rabbi Akiva she is completely exempt [even from chalitzah].

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:2:1.hebrew: ארבעה אחין ס"ד - כיון דלא הוו אלא ד', וכולן מתו — כדקתני "מתו" — מאן מייבם:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:2:1.english: Four brothers, could it enter your mind - Since there were only four, and all of them died — as [the Mishnah] teaches, "died" — who performs levirate marriage?

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:3:1.hebrew: ושבקינן ליה - בתמיה, ובמה יפרנס כולן:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:3:1.english: And do we leave him [to do so] - [This is asked] in astonishment: and with what will he support all of them?

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:5:1.english: Where it is possible for him - For he is wealthy and able to sustain them.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:5:2.hebrew: עונה בחדש - עונה של ת"ח מערב שבת לערב שבת, וזהו "אשר פריו יתן בעתו" בכתובות (דף סב:), דמטי לכל חדא עונה בחדש:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:5:2.english: Conjugal duty in a month - The conjugal duty of Torah scholars is from Shabbat eve to Shabbat eve — and this is [the meaning of] "which yields its fruit in its season" in Ketubot (62b) — so that each one receives conjugal duty [once] in a month.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:8:1.english: And let him perform levirate marriage with one - First, and afterward let him perform chalitzah with the [other] one.

Rashi on Yevamot 44a:8:2.hebrew: כל שאינה עולה - לבית דין לייבום, שאינה זקוקה להתייבם, דרחמנא פטרה, דכתיב "את בית אחיו" — בית אחד הוא בונה ולא שני בתים — אינו עולה לחליצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 44a:8:2.english: Any [woman] who does not go up - to the court for levirate marriage, [meaning] that she is not bound to undergo levirate marriage, for the Merciful One exempted her, as it is written: "his brother's house" [Deuteronomy 25:9] — one house he builds, and not two houses — does not go up for chalitzah.

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:10:1.hebrew: כי איכא תרתי לא תתקיים מצות ייבום - תימה, דא"כ למה לי קרא דאין חולץ לשני בתים:
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:10:1.english: "When there are two [wives], the mitzvah of levirate marriage is not fulfilled" - [This is] astonishing, for if so, why do I need a verse [teaching] that one does not perform chalitzah for two houses [i.e., two wives]?

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:12:1.hebrew: אלמה לא איצטריך סד"א ערוה אבראי קיימא - הקשה הר"ר יו"ט בר' יצחק: אכתי צרת צרה היכי משכחת לה? שהרי צרת ערוה אינה יכולה לינשא לאחיו השני, דאסורה לו מדאורייתא, דגבי דידיה ערוה לאו אבראי קיימא. וי"ל, דמשכחת לה כגון שהערוה היא מחייבי עשה או ל"ת ועשה לכל האחין, דלאו בת יבום היא, וצרתה שריא:
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:12:1.english: "Why not? It is necessary; it could enter your mind to say [that] the forbidden relation stands outside" - Rabbi Yom Tov son of Rabbi Yitzchak asked: Still, how can a case of a rival wife of a rival wife occur? For the rival wife of a forbidden relation cannot marry his second brother, since she is forbidden to him by Torah law, as with respect to him the forbidden relation does not stand outside [the calculation]. And one can answer that it occurs in a case where the forbidden relation is among those [forbidden] by a positive commandment or by a negative and positive commandment to all the brothers, so that she is not subject to levirate marriage, and [thus] her rival wife is permitted:

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:20:1.hebrew: ודילמא קסתים לן תנא כשמעון התימני - תימה, דסתם ואח"כ מחלוקת היא! דכהאי גוונא פריך בפרק יש נוחלין (ב"ב דף קכב:): "וכי תאמר סתם לן תנא כרבי יוחנן בן ברוקא — סתם ואח"כ מחלוקת היא!" וי"ל: דנהי דאין חשיב סתם, מ"מ חשיב כרבים לגבי יחיד, כדפרישית לעיל; ובפ' יש נוחלין סמיך אקושיא אחריתי, דקאמר: "ועוד, מאי אלא":
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:20:1.english: "But perhaps the tanna taught us as unattributed [a mishna] in accordance with Shimon HaTimni" - This is puzzling, for it is an unattributed [mishna] followed by a dispute! For in a similar manner, [the Gemara] asks in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Nochalin (Bava Batra 122b): "And if you say that the tanna taught us as unattributed [a mishna] in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka — it is an unattributed [mishna] followed by a dispute!" And one can answer: although it is not considered an unattributed [mishna], nevertheless it is considered like a majority against an individual, as I explained above; and in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Nochalin, [the Gemara] relies on another difficulty, as it says: "And furthermore, what is [the meaning of] 'rather'?"

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:20:2.hebrew: אם כן לשמעינן שאר חייבי כריתות - אכתי ה"מ למיפרך: תנינא, דסתם לן תנא כוותיה בקדושין בפרק האומר (דף סו:): "כל מקום שאין קדושין כו' ואיזה זה הבא על אחת מכל העריות":
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:20:2.english: "If so, let [him] inform us [of] other [forbidden relations] liable to karet" - Still, [the Gemara] could have objected: We already learned [this in a Mishnah], for the tanna taught anonymously in accordance with him in Kiddushin, in the chapter [entitled] HaOmer (66b): "Wherever there is no betrothal, etc., and which [case] is this? One who has relations with any of the forbidden relations."

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:23:1.hebrew: הכל מודים במחזיר גרושתו - לרבותא נקט מחזיר גרושתו טפי משאר חייבי לאוין, דאף על גב דכתיב "היא תועבה", ואין בניה תועבין, פגום מיהא הוי:
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:23:1.english: All agree in [the case of] one who remarries his divorcée - [The Gemara] specifically cited one who remarries his divorcée to teach a greater novelty than [in the case of] other [unions] forbidden by a negative commandment: for even though it is written, "She is an abomination" [from which it is derived that] her children are not abominations, [the child] is nevertheless of flawed [lineage].

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:8:1.hebrew: ונייבם לחדא ונחלוץ לחדא אמר קרא אם לא יחפוץ כו' - אית ספרים דגרסי מקמי הכי: ונחלוץ לחדא ונייבם לחדא, אמר קרא "אשר לא יבנה" — כיון שלא בנה שוב לא יבנה. ונראה דל"ג, דלא צריך קרא להכי, דכיון דחליץ לחדא א"א לייבם שניה, כיון דאין עולה לחליצה, כדאמר לעיל דאינו חולץ שני בתים. ועוד, ד"אינו חולץ לשני בתים" משמע דהשניה מותרת לשוק בולא כלום. וקרא ד"לא יבנה" אייתר לכדדרשינן פ"ק (לעיל יבמות דף י: ושם) לנתק החלוצה מכרת ללאו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:8:1.english: But let him consummate the levirate marriage with one and perform ḥalitza with the other; the verse states: "If he does not wish," etc. - There are texts that read before this: "But let him perform ḥalitza with one and consummate the levirate marriage with the other? The verse states: 'Who will not build' — once he has not built, he may not build again." And it appears that we do not read [this], for a verse is not needed for this, since once he performs ḥalitza with one, it is impossible to consummate the levirate marriage with the second, since she is not eligible for ḥalitza, as [the Gemara] stated above that he does not perform ḥalitza with two houses. Furthermore, "he does not perform ḥalitza with two houses" implies that the second [woman] is permitted to [marry anyone in] the general public without anything [further]. And the verse "he will not build" is superfluous [and is used] for what we expound in the first chapter (above, Yevamot 10b, and there): to remove the ḥalutza from [the penalty of] karet to a negative prohibition.

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:8:2.hebrew: כל שאינו עולה כו' - וא"ת: והרי חרש וחרשת דאינן עולים לחליצה ועולים לייבום, כדאמר בפרק חרש (לקמן יבמות דף קיב:)? ויש לומר: דהתם בני חליצה נינהו, אלא דפומייהו הוא דכאיב להו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:8:2.english: "One who is ineligible, etc." - And if you ask: Behold, a deaf-mute man and a deaf-mute woman are ineligible for ḥalitza yet eligible for levirate marriage, as stated in the chapter [entitled] Ḥeresh (later, Yevamot 112b)? And one can answer: There, they are [in principle] fit for ḥalitza, except that it is their mouth that pains them [i.e., they are physically unable to recite the verses].

Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:9:1.hebrew: ועוד - לא גרסינן "ועוד גזרה שמא יאמרו בית מקצתו" כו', דאי מדאורייתא מייבם לחדא וחליץ לחדא, משום גזרה לא יניח:
Tosafot on Yevamot 44a:9:1.english: And furthermore - We do not read [the text as] "And furthermore, [it is] a decree lest they say, '[the] house is partially [built,]'" etc., for if by Torah law he could consummate levirate marriage with one [wife] and perform ḥalitza with one, he would not refrain [from doing so] on account of a decree.
